subject: Post-call: Security discovery, incident response timeline & BCP evidence
messages:
From: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@medcorehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medcorehealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Vanessa — thanks for the call today. High level: our security and legal teams asked for a succinct follow-up so they can evaluate Redwood for a pilot. Two asks up front that I couldn't confirm on the call and need in writing:

1) SOC 2 status: do you have a SOC 2 Type II report we can review (most recent year)?
2) Incident response / breach notification cadence: if you were to detect an incident that could impact customer data, what is your standard notification SLA and what evidence do you provide (post-incident report, root-cause, timelines)?

Also, we need a short BCP/DR summary for our vendor review — ideally an exec summary we can attach to the vendor questionnaire. Can you point me to the right attachments or next steps?

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Brown
Head of InfoSec Risk
MedCore Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Olivia — great to meet you today, appreciate the clear asks. Per our call summary and to make it easy for your security team, I'm outlining the items and next steps below. Karthik and Markus are looped in for the specifics and evidence handoff.

Summary (short):
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit covering controls as of Dec 31, 2025. We can share the report under an NDA.
- Incident response / breach notification: Redwood maintains an incident response runbook. Severity-based customer notifications: we notify impacted customers within 72 hours for incidents involving customer data; for high-severity incidents impacting availability we notify within 24 hours. Post-incident we provide a technical incident report (timeline, root cause, mitigation, and remediation plan).
- BCP/DR: we have an executive BCP/DR summary that covers RTO/RPO targets for hosted services, recovery playbooks, and third-party continuity dependencies.

Requested next steps:
1) I'll share a stubbed SOC 2 report and our exec BCP summary to your security mailbox (attached) — redacted for public distribution.
2) Karthik will send a short incident-response timeline template and a sample post-incident report for you to review (so you can validate the format with your legal/compliance).
3) If you prefer an NDA before full SOC 2 delivery let us know — we can provide our standard MSA/NDA link.

Deliverables & timing:
- SOC 2 stub + BCP exec summary: by EOD Wed 2026-03-11 (attached).
- IR timeline template + sample report: by Thu 2026-03-12 (Karthik).
- Follow-up call to review artifacts with your security team: propose Tue 2026-03-16, 10am PT — confirm if that works.

If anything here is off the mark, tell me and I'll correct.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Accounts — West
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0173

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: IR timeline template + sample report (per Vanessa)

Olivia — attaching a concise incident-response timeline template and a redacted sample post-incident report. The sample is anonymized but preserves the structure: detection timestamp, containment actions, root-cause analysis, customer impact summary, mitigation steps, and preventive measures.

Attachment stub list:
- IR_Timeline_Template.docx (stub)
- Sample_Post_Incident_Report_redacted.pdf (stub)

A few clarifications on notification SLAs so your team can quote accurately:
- Detection & initial triage: within 4 hours of internally identified suspicious activity (we begin containment immediately).
- Customer notification (data-impacting incidents): initial notification within 72 hours after confirmation of impact.
- Availability-impacting incidents: initial notification within 24 hours (we prioritize availability SLO communications).
- Final report: provided within 10 business days for straightforward incidents; complex root-cause analysis may take up to 30 business days with interim updates.

If MedCore requires accelerated notification timelines or contractual SLA commitments, Markus (cc'd) can provide options for contractual terms and escalation paths (we have enterprise clauses available for dedicated deployments).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@medcorehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medcorehealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IR timeline template + sample report (per Vanessa)

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our Security team after reviewing the templates:

1) For the 72-hour notification, can you confirm whether the clock starts at detection or confirmation of customer-impact? Our policy group expects clock to start at confirmation of customer-impact, but they want the detection-to-confirmation average to be stated for planning.
2) For the final report timeline, their risk committee prefers a maximum of 15 business days for incidents that affect PHI. Do you have contractual language or precedent for HIPAA/PHI-specific timelines?
3) We will also be sending you our vendor security questionnaire (NDA executed) — please expect ~30 Qs, a mix of checkbox and short-answer items. Can you confirm an internal owner and expected turnaround?

If you can provide short answers to the three bullets, we can move this to our procurement queue.

Olivia

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Brown <olivia.brown@medcorehealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IR timeline template + sample report (per Vanessa)

Olivia — thanks for the specific asks. Short, factual responses below so you can pass them to procurement: 

1) 72-hour notification clock: starts at confirmation of customer-impact. That said, we notify customers of detection/triage activity earlier if there are indicators of possible impact and we will label those updates as "preliminary detection notices." For your planning, our average detection-to-confirmation for the last 12 months (global) was ~36 hours (median).

2) HIPAA/PHI-specific final reports: for customers handling PHI we can contractually commit to a maximum of 15 business days for the final post-incident report for incidents involving PHI. We have precedent clauses in enterprise contracts and will include this in an addendum for pilot customers requiring HIPAA obligations.

3) Vendor questionnaire ownership & turnaround: Redwood will assign an internal owner from our security ops team for questionnaires. Standard turnaround for a ~30-question vendor security questionnaire is 5 business days from receipt (if the questions are standard checkbox + short answers). If deeper evidence collection or a request for raw artifacts is required, timeline will be extended and we will provide an estimated completion date within 48 hours of receiving the questionnaire.

Attachments provided to MedCore (redacted/stubs):
- SOC2_Type2_redwood_2025.pdf (redacted SOC 2 Type II executive summary)
- BCP_Runbook_Executive_Summary.pdf (exec-level BCP/DR summary)

Next steps (operational):
- Vanessa: if MedCore sends the questionnaire to security@medcorehealth.com, our security ops owner will pick it up and confirm receipt + ETA within 48 hours.
- Proposed artifact review with your security team: Tue 2026-03-16 at 10am PT (per Vanessa) — please confirm or propose an alternative.

Happy to jump on the call if you want Markus to walk through the SOC evidence and IR templates.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
